notes.title: Next Big Update
notes.content:
Hello Acclimate Testers!

We realize it's been a significant amount of time since our last update, and we wanted to share with you some insights into what's been happening. During our development process, we identified a few additional issues that required attention before we could release the next big update. As many of you know from your testing experiences, the initial state of the game was quite basic—essentially just a map and a character. Our aim for this upcoming update is to present a more refined game experience, complete with engaging content and activities.

To achieve this, we've overhauled several of the game's systems and implemented numerous improvements to enhance playability and increase frame rates. We're eager to roll out this update in the upcoming month, assuming our final tests go as planned. Your role in this process is invaluable; we rely on your continued dedication to testing the game and reporting any bugs you encounter. Our goal with this update is to elevate the game to a more complete state and finally transition out of the Alpha phase.

We apologize for the delay and want to express our sincere gratitude for your patience and understanding. Given that we're a small team of just three people, we're doing our utmost to ensure quality and progress. Thank you all for your ongoing support and commitment to making Acclimate the best game it can be.
